metadata.source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Data Profiles & Passaic County 2026 Certified Rolls

zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Haskell & Midvale Corridor, Midvale & Conklintown Reservoir Border
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 4.541%, with an equalization ratio of 58.18%.
Public education represents 59.8% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 25.1%.
Average residential assessment is $276,355, producing an average annual tax bill of $12,549.28.

neighborhoods.name: Haskell & Midvale Corridor
neighborhoods.character: Suburban single-family homes, cape cods, and townhome communities bordering Wanaque Reservoir
neighborhoods.description: Township bordering the massive Wanaque Reservoir, featuring Lakeland Regional High School campus.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Receives state Payments in Lieu of Taxes (PILOT) for North Jersey District Water Supply Commission lands.

neighborhoods.name: Midvale & Conklintown Reservoir Border
neighborhoods.character: Suburban residences and ranches bordering Norvin Green forest and reservoir hillsides
neighborhoods.description: Quiet residential neighborhood offering walking access to Wanaque Elementary School.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Predictable tax rates with shared regional school efficiencies.

equityAnalysis.summary: Wanaque Borough maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Wanaque Borough, homeowners pay an average of $12,549.28 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 11.97% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 58.18%, assessed values average ~58.18% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 59.8% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 25.1%, and Passaic County claims 15.1%.
